name: Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct
notes: Small mixture-of-experts vision model. The card lists OCRBench 867 and InfoVQA 83.2. The Instruct checkpoint does not think; the Thinking-2506 version scores a little higher but writes long reasoning first. 8-bit weights alone would fill most of a 20 GB slice, so it runs on 40 GB. Not yet run on BAM hardware.
status_note: Not run yet. Needs the weights on sv1223.
